t: A single Adafruit guide for making a school binder that lights up with circuit stickers.
steps: Find the Circuit Sticker School Binder guide on Adafruit Learn.
Buy Chibitronics circuit stickers, including starter, sensor, effects, and LED packs.
Buy copper tape, CR2032 batteries, and binders.
Print the light sensor, effect, and battery holder templates.
Have students lay the copper tape and stickers.
Fold the paper battery holder with the on/off flap.
